digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment truncation at 32767 characters, matching Jira Data Center's default jira.text.field.character.limit, but silently truncates comments when a DC administrator has raised or removed this limit, causing data loss
The 32767 constant in WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is correct for stock Jira 7.0+ but wrong for configured instances; the defect window opens only where an admin has changed the limit from its default

sanitize_comment reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, coupling two separate concerns such that future changes to description fitting would silently retarget comments, violating the single-responsibility principle
DC comment ceiling must be configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, allowing operators to match their instance's jira.text.field.character.limit setting

The endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings is admin-only and inaccessible to rebar's ordinary-user PAT, so runtime discovery is not viable and configuration is the required remedy
